import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_dir = 'outputs'

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
info_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in info_cols]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
indicator_data = df[indicator_cols]
missing_counts = indicator_data.isnull().sum()
missing_rates = indicator_data.isnull().mean()

# Create missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_data.columns,
    'missing_count': missing_counts.values,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates.values,
    'kept': missing_rates <= 0.30
})
missingness_report.to_csv(f'{output_dir}/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_mask = missing_rates <= 0.30
kept_indicators = [col for col, rate in zip(indicator_cols, missing_rates) if rate <= 0.30]

# Select only the required columns
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv(f'{output_dir}/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)

print(f"Missingness report saved to {output_dir}/t12_missingness_report.csv")
print(f"Selected matrix saved to {output_dir}/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
print(f"Kept {len(kept_indicators)} indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30")
